title: Power reporting — replace the rainbow diagram

steps.path: Power → Right now; also shown on Overview
steps.headline: Which layout should replace the rainbow power diagram?
steps.notice: Both remove gradients and animation, separate adapter output from net battery flow, and make the battery's contribution large and red while draining.
steps.risk: These are actual dashboard renders with fixed example readings, not live power measurements. Nothing is installed. Quick settings is not restyled here.

variants.label: Clean connections
variants.summary: Adapter and battery are separate sources feeding one machine. Thin lines show the relationship; CPU, GPU and Other remain grouped below.
variants.risk: Taller than the compact version. Negative battery watts mean loss from the battery, while the adapter shows power supplied.

variants.label: Power breakdown
variants.summary: A compact total with adapter contribution and a prominent red battery-drain row. My recommendation for the quickest reading; no connector diagram.
variants.risk: The two-source relationship is explained by labels and a flat split bar rather than wires.
